doc: 3D LUT (Adobe / DaVinci Resolve `.cube`, LUT_3D_SIZE 2..64; 1D LUTs and malformed files are rejected and the filter does nothing). The straight colour is normalised through the file's domain, u = clamp((c - DOMAIN_MIN) / (DOMAIN_MAX - DOMAIN_MIN)), looked up with trilinear interpolation (red index fastest in the file, blue slowest) and mixed with the original by intensity / 100. Table outputs are stored in 8 bit and clipped to 0..1. Alpha unchanged.
